final_message:
`RESULTS.json` is written. Summary of Q2 2026 (120 transactions, Apr–Jun, converted at `rates.csv` and per-transaction cent-rounded):

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Total Q2 spend | €44,023.75 |
| MoM May (vs Apr) | +9.8% |
| MoM Jun (vs May) | +10.0% |
| Largest transaction | €1,312.26 |
| Mean transaction | €366.86 |
| Travel share | 27.6% |
| Over budget | travel (€12,137.98 / €10,300), software (€9,702.03 / €8,200) |

Category totals: hardware €8,874.09 · meals €2,541.26 · office €1,775.45 · software €9,702.03 · training €8,992.94 · travel €12,137.98.

Cross-checks: category totals and monthly totals (€13,316.21 / €14,623.21 / €16,084.33) both sum exactly to €44,023.75, and the mean reconciles (44,023.75 / 120). Data was clean — all six categories are budgeted, all three months are in Q2, and every amount was well-formed.
